column1: # Fail-closed fixtures for the commentary profile (DESIGN.md 17.6, T24).
# Each line turns good.xml into a bad file by replacing <old> (which must occur
# in good.xml exactly once) with <new>; the result must be refused.
# Columns (TAB-separated): id, the Rust check that must fire, who must refuse it
# ("both": the Rust pipeline and the Python reader mhcc_osis.py; "rust": only
# the Rust pipeline, because the check needs the KJV table), old, new.
# Escapes in old/new: \n = LF, \t = TAB, \r = CR, \\ = backslash, \u{hex} = that
# Event forms (M1-F3): containers as Empty, milestones as containers
# (quick-xml's end-name check refuses `</title >` before the tag-spelling check sees it)
